notes.title: Version 1.2.0: Gamepad controls added and updated.
notes.notes:
To improve the gamepad experience, I’ve added new control options and changed the menu button.
Keyboard controls remain the same.

New gamepad inputs:

[list]
[*] Left hand: Left stick, D-Pad
[*] Right hand: Right stick, right-side buttons (XYAB / ⚪︎△□×)
[*] Open menu: Start button(XBox:Menu/Switch:+/DualShock:Option)
[/list]

Stick controls still work as before.
Added button-only input for players who prefer not to use sticks.

Feel free to share your impressions on the community board or X!
Keep improving based on your feedback.

Enjoy the brain-bending experience!

notes.title: Planning to add more control options for gamepads.
notes.notes:
Thank you for checking out our game.
This is Finger tip, the developer of Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands.

In an upcoming update, we plan to add support for button-only controls—no sticks required.
The current stick controls will still be available, but you’ll also be able to control the left hand using the D-pad and the right hand using the four face buttons.
As part of this, the button for opening the menu will be changed to the Start button.

Here’s a summary of the input changes:

Current Controls

Left Hand: Left Stick
Right Hand: Right Stick
Open Menu: Y (Xbox), X (Switch), △ (PlayStation)
New Controls

Left Hand: Left Stick, D-pad
Right Hand: Right Stick, Face Buttons (XYAB / ⚪︎△□×)
Open Menu: Start Button
These updates should make the game more accessible and easier to control.
Stay tuned!

notes.title: "Hypothesis on the Symmetry of Vision and Hands" Early Access Begins!
notes.notes:
If you're reading this, it means you're interested—thank you so much!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949109/ed643b62de10b86ba8bc0e935cace03abae5e000.gif[/img]

This is a simple action game where your brain might glitch as you control the right and left hands independently.

Here are the key features as intended by the developer:
[list]
[*] Control the right hand with your right hand and the left hand with your left hand—prepare for your brain to glitch as you lose track of left and right.
[*] If your brain doesn't glitch, you can complete the game in about an hour.
[*] Aim for top scores and rankings in time attack mode.
[/list]

We showcased the game at Comiket, Japan's largest doujin event, and received great feedback.
This is a project we're confident in, so please give it a try!

notes.title: Attended Comic Market 104.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, it’s been a while.

I attended Comic Market 104 to verify whether the gameplay experience of our game, Hypothesis on the Symmetry Between Vision and Hand, aligns with our intentions.

We had participants try the game using a gamepad. They controlled the right hand with the right stick and the left hand with the left stick, and we observed if the game successfully induced a sense of confusion in the brain.

Many people repeatedly attempted the game, voicing their confusion and frustration, which indicates they were engaged. Based on this, I believe players will thoroughly enjoy the game.

I'm excited about the start of Early Access. Please stay tuned!
